     origin_provider TEXT NOT NULL,
     origin_model TEXT NOT NULL,

     started_at INTEGER,
     finished_at INTEGER

     ON workflow_runs(project_id, created_at DESC);
   CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS workflow_runs_status_created_idx
     ON workflow_runs(status, created_at);

     id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
     run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

     options_json TEXT NOT NULL,

     resolved_reasoning_level TEXT NOT NULL,

     result_json TEXT,

     started_at INTEGER,
     finished_at INTEGER,
     UNIQUE(run_id, call_index)
   );
   CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS workflow_calls_run_idx
     ON workflow_calls(run_id, call_index);
   CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS workflow_calls_child_idx
     ON workflow_calls(child_thread_id);

CREATE TABLE workflow_artifact_blobs (
     sha256 TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(sha256) = 64),
     content_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(content_type IN ('text/markdown', 'text/html', 'application/json')),
     content BLOB NOT NULL,
     byte_length INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_length >= 0),
     created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
     CHECK(length(content) = byte_length)
   );
   CREATE TABLE workflow_artifacts (
     campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     environment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     presentation_thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     id TEXT NOT NULL,
     kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('requirements', 'architecture', 'decision-log')),
     title TEXT NOT NULL,
     content_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(content_type IN ('text/markdown', 'text/html', 'application/json')),
     created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
     updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, project_id, environment_id, presentation_thread_id, id),
     UNIQUE (campaign_id, project_id, environment_id, presentation_thread_id, kind)
   );
   CREATE TABLE workflow_artifact_revisions (
     campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     project_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     environment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     presentation_thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     artifact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision >= 1),
     blob_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workflow_artifact_blobs(sha256) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
     status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('draft', 'accepted-pending-impact', 'admitted', 'superseded')),
     source_host_id TEXT,
     source_root_path TEXT,
     source_relative_path TEXT,
     source_sha256 TEXT,
     produced_by_thread_id TEXT,
     created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
     PRIMARY KEY (campaign_id, project_id, environment_id, presentation_thread_id, artifact_id, revision),
     FOREIGN KEY (campaign_id, project_id, environment_id, presentation_thread_id, artifact_id)
       REFERENCES workflow_artifacts(campaign_id, project_id, environment_id, presentation_thread_id, id)
       ON DELETE RESTRICT,
     CHECK (
       (source_host_id IS NULL AND source_root_path IS NULL AND source_relative_path IS NULL AND source_sha256 IS NULL)
       OR
       (source_host_id IS NOT NULL AND source_root_path IS NOT NULL AND source_relative_path IS NOT NULL AND source_sha256 IS NOT NULL)
     )
   );
   CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workflow_artifact_one_admitted_revision_idx
     ON workflow_artifact_revisions(campaign_id, project_id, environment_id, presentation_thread_id, artifact_id)

encoding.leaf: SHA-256 UTF-8(domainTag + U+0000 + canonical JSON leaf)

graph.components: connected components union target-identity hyperedges plus explicit FK, BLOB-reference, presentation-provenance edges
graph.partition: by component and authority with multiplicity

parity.equation: every noncolliding origin/component remains canonical active
every conflicting component has no synthesized active artifact

completion.ddl: CREATE TABLE _bb_plugin_migration_completions (authority_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, predecessor_authority_id TEXT, outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(outcome IN ('ordinary','recovered')), applied_high_water_mark INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(applied_high_water_mark >= 0), statement_vector_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(statement_vector_sha256) = 64), descriptor_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(descriptor_sha256) = 64), plugin_semantic_receipt_sha256 TEXT CHECK(plugin_semantic_receipt_sha256 IS NULL OR length(plugin_semantic_receipt_sha256) = 64), completed_verification_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(completed_verification_sha256) = 64), completed_at INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (predecessor_authority_id) REFERENCES _bb_plugin_migration_completions(authority_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT);
completion.write: exactly one in same host transaction as terminal effects

verifier.startup: every startup/no-op/restart before settings service CLI RPC renderer UI live-change registration

vectors.execution: same corpus through separate production and fake SQLite adapters; effects required; real workflows V3 plan through production; no constant/parser/toy/zero-selection/skips

collisionFixtureValues.mergeAlgorithm: take the named base row, replace exactly the listed field with the literal alternate; arrays are replaced and no field is inferred

collisions.field: kind,title,content_type equal; created_at MIN; updated_at MAX

parity.equation: every noncolliding origin/component remains canonical active
every conflicting component has no synthesized active artifact

transaction.storageGap: stop and freeze appended migration; never edit 18 or 22

legacy.requiredForAdoption: separate sealed provenance and read-only integrity evidence

admission.constructionGate: approval exists passes exact manifest unchanged bytes zero findings
admission.repair: changed authority/projection/state/fault field requires new authority ID and fresh A0

digests.algorithm: SHA-256 UTF-8(domain+U+0000+compact canonical JSON); recursive Unicode-codepoint object keys; arrays preserved
